verdict.rationale: Babylon.js is a rendering framework, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it. A runtime probe explicitly found no official MCP server, only a small, idle community repo, which is not first-party. The llms.txt files are a different capability and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
